label: thm:linear_time
title: Linear-time bound in the abstract cost model
statement:
The total abstract cost of the linear sieve up to $n$ is at most
    \[
        (n-1) + (2n-2) = 3n-3.
    \]
    In particular, the sieve runs in linear time:
    \[
        \mathrm{cost} = O(n).
    \]
proof: Sum the outer-loop cost ($n-1$ by \ref{lem:outer_iterations_bound}) and the inner-loop cost (at most $2n-2$ by \ref{lem:all_inner_visits_bound}).
